name: MonarchDonutChart
title: DonutChart
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas (DrawScope.drawArc and drawCircle) and androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicText with TextAutoSize for the center; inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend and MonarchChartTable
summary: Parts of one whole as a donut inside a chart frame: the total in the middle, a legend of values and shares, folding of small segments into Other, and every segment in the data table.
whenToUse: For two to six parts of one whole where the share matters more than an exact comparison, such as assets by type on a dashboard card.
whenNotToUse: To compare or rank parts precisely, or for many categories, use MonarchBarList or MonarchBarChart. For values that change over time or do not add up to a whole, use MonarchBarChart.
api: @Composable fun MonarchDonutChart(title: String, segments: List<MonarchDonutChartSegment>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, centerValue: String? = null, centerLabel: String? = null, summary: String? = null, sort: MonarchDonutChartSort = MonarchDonutChartSort.Descending, maxSegments: Int = 6, legendContent: MonarchDonutChartLegendContent = MonarchDonutChartLegendContent.Both, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, size: Dp? = null, thickness: Dp? = null, percentDigits: Int = 0, showCenterValue: Boolean = true, showLegend: Boolean = true, tableToggle: Boolean = true, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, labels: MonarchDonutChartLabels = MonarchDonutChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchDonutChartSegment(key: String, label: String, value: Double, color: MonarchChartColor? = null)

class MonarchDonutChartLabels(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), other: String? = null, segment: String? = null, value: String? = null, share: String? = null, total: String? = null)
enum class MonarchDonutChartLegendContent { Both, Value, Percent, None }

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the donut's spoken name.

options.name: segments
options.description: The parts: key, label, value (negative and non-finite count as 0) and an optional color slot.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the frame.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title.

options.name: centerValue
options.description: The large text in the middle.

options.name: centerLabel
options.description: Small text under the center value, such as "assets".

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary.

options.name: sort
options.description: The largest slice first, or the given order.

options.name: maxSegments
options.description: The most slices drawn (at least 2); the smallest beyond it fold into a neutral Other slice.

options.name: legendContent
options.description: What each legend entry shows after its label: Both ("412 · 48%"), Value, Percent or None.

options.name: status
options.description: Ready, Loading, Empty or Error. Ready with a total of 0 shows Empty.

options.name: size
options.description: The outer diameter, and the height kept in every status.

options.name: thickness
options.description: The ring's thickness, kept between 4dp and half the size.

options.name: percentDigits
options.description: Decimal places in shares.

options.name: showCenterValue
options.description: Whether the middle shows the center value and label.

options.name: showLegend
options.description: Whether the frame shows the legend.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Other, Segment, Value, Share, Total and the frame's strings.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values in the center, the legend, the table, TalkBack and the summary. A number in the current locale by default.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

states.name: ready
states.description: The donut with its center text, and the legend in the frame's legend row.

states.name: folded
states.description: With more segments than maxSegments, the smallest are drawn as one Other slice in the neutral color; the legend and the slice elements show Other, the table lists every segment.

states.name: table
states.description: "View as table" replaces the donut with every segment, then the total, with Value and Share columns.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's skeleton of the donut's height, read as "Loading chart".

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No data yet"; also shown when the total is 0.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error, with Try again when onRetry is set.

appearance: Slices take the theme's data colors 1 to 5 in order and Other the subtle text color, over a ring in the muted background color that shows in the gaps between slices. The center value is heading text in the default text color, the center label caption text in the muted color. Legend markers are squares. Every color is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Drawn with a Compose Canvas and drawArc (iOS uses Swift Charts SectorMark, the web SVG circles); Android has no first-party chart library and Monarch adds none. The legend is the frame's legend row above the donut, wrapping onto new rows, instead of a column beside it as on iOS and the web: the frame keeps the body at a fixed height, and a column beside a 160dp donut would be cut at large font sizes. As on iOS, slices are not interactive (the web dims the other slices on hover); every value and share is in the legend, in one TalkBack element per slice and in the table. The center value is a String rather than any node. There is no chart descriptor like iOS's Audio Graphs on Android. In right to left the slices run anticlockwise from the top.
accessibility: The donut is one element with the image role, named by the title, whose state description is the generated summary ("Total 865. Laptops 412 (48%), …") or the summary parameter.
After it, one element per drawn slice, in slice order (traversal index), placed on the ring and read as its name, value and share; Other is read with its folded total.
The center text is hidden from TalkBack, because the summary already reads the total.
Each legend entry is one element read as its label then its value and share; the color marker is decoration.
"View as table" shows every segment, the total and the shares as text; each row is read as the segment, then its value and share.
Every built-in word (Other, Segment, Value, Share, Total and the frame's strings) can be replaced through labels.
edgeCases: Negative and non-finite values count as 0; a total of 0 shows the empty state.
A share that rounds to 0 reads "<1%" and one that rounds to the whole without being it ">99%", so rounding never hides a segment; a tiny slice keeps a sliver of 2dp along the ring.
maxSegments below 2 is treated as 2, so Other never stands alone.
A long center value or label shrinks to half its size, then is cut with an ellipsis, to stay inside the hole at large text sizes.
Long legend labels wrap; many entries wrap onto new rows above the donut.
The slice elements and the summary were checked with Robolectric semantics tests, not with TalkBack on a device.

examples.title: Assets by type
examples.template:
MonarchDonutChart(
    title = {{title}},
    segments = listOf(
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.0.key}}, {{segments.0.label}}, {{segments.0.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.1.key}}, {{segments.1.label}}, {{segments.1.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.2.key}}, {{segments.2.label}}, {{segments.2.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.3.key}}, {{segments.3.label}}, {{segments.3.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.4.key}}, {{segments.4.label}}, {{segments.4.value|double}}),
    ),
    description = {{description}},
    centerLabel = {{centerLabel}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchDonutChart(
    title = "Assets by type",
    segments = listOf(
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("laptop", "Laptops", 412.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("phone", "Phones", 268.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("monitor", "Monitors", 131.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("tablet", "Tablets", 54.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("other", "Accessories", 9.0),
    ),
    description = "All active assets",
    centerLabel = "assets",
)

examples.title: Shares only, a custom center and a pinned neutral slice
examples.code:
MonarchDonutChart(
    title = "Storage",
    segments = listOf(
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("files", "Files", 820.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("backups", "Backups", 540.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("free", "Free", 640.0, color = MonarchChartColor.Neutral),
    ),
    centerValue = "68%",
    centerLabel = "used",
    sort = MonarchDonutChartSort.None,
    legendContent = MonarchDonutChartLegendContent.Percent,
    formatValue = { "${it.toInt()} GB" },
)
